prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 83.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.1%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Interactive Pet Preview & Redesign', 'Cloud Backup Account Reassurance', 'Account Pet Sync Guarantee Callout', 'Story Scroll Path Selection Layout', 'Existing Pet Account Sync Callout', 'Path Reassurance Story Copy']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Interactive Desktop Onboarding Stage', 'Deferred Sign-in After Adoption', 'Real-time Waiting Progress & Taskbar Tips', 'Interactive Pet Styling Flow', 'Desktop Display Diagnostic Hint', 'Desktop Tray Notification Prompt', 'Path Selection Card Grid', 'Desktop Control Quick Guide Screen', 'Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Mini-Game', 'Pet Style Preview Gallery Screen', 'Pet Creation Progress Tracker', 'Path Guidance Hint on Story Screen', 'Split Screen Pet Adoption & Certificate Hub', 'Account Pet Recovery Safety Guarantee', 'Desktop Tray Quick-Access Notification', 'Desktop Rendering Verification Flow', 'Two-Column Path Choice Layout', 'Adoption Guarantee Copy Refresh', 'Desktop Spawn Sound Alert', 'Desktop Pet Interaction Tutorial Screen', 'Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint', 'Pick Friend Grid Selection Layout', 'Generation Time Estimate & Progress Tracker', 'Story First Auth Reordering', 'Desktop Background Ready Chime Prompt', 'Custom Pet Creation Photo Diagnostic Screen', 'Desktop Display Compatibility Hint', 'Desktop Rendering Verification Status', 'Account Pet Sync & Recovery Hint', 'Photo Generation Quality Check Screen', 'Desktop Controls Interactive Mascot Walkthrough', 'Desktop Rendering Stage Status Counter']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Spotlight Pick Friend Mascot Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a spotlight layout featuring an interactive mascot preview and playful animation highlights.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a sharp drop (63.2% conversion rate) and takes 89s median time; a spotlight focus makes pet options clearer and more engaging.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Controls Onboarding Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated new onboarding screen right after home intro explaining shortcuts and tray options for controlling, hiding, and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: Support logs show multiple tickets from users confused about how to control or hide their pet after completing onboarding.

new_desktop_controls.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_controls.body: Use Alt+P to toggle pet visibility or right-click your pet to access interaction options anytime.

candidates.title: Story Auth First Reorder Journey
candidates.change: Move sign-in immediately before path selection so account connection occurs prior to pet creation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing after signing in again; securing account identity up front ensures pet state persistence.

candidates.title: Multi-Stage Taskbar Setup Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a taskbar readiness checklist flow on the waiting screen to guide desktop rendering permissions.
candidates.why: Home wait time is extremely long (mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported desktop pets failing to render or open.

components.text: Check system tray visibility and display permissions.

candidates.title: Compact Photo Upload Drop Zone Layout
candidates.change: Re-layout the custom photo upload screen using a compact layout with photo guidance tips.
candidates.why: Custom pet creation fails or looks wrong for multiple users, contributing to the adoption drop-off.

components.text: For best results, upload high-resolution, well-lit photographs.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Shortcuts Intro Copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro text to explicitly detail hotkeys and right-click interaction options.
candidates.why: Users report confusion post-onboarding regarding how to interact with or hide their pet on desktop.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is ready for your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet to bring up interactions, or press Alt+P to hide it into your taskbar.

candidates.title: Account Recovery Safety Notice Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on sign_in clarifying that signing in guarantees existing pets remain synced and recoverable.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets pertained to lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in binds your pet creations to your cloud profile so you never lose them.

candidates.title: Background Generation Time Indicator
candidates.change: Show progress and estimated time indicators alongside helpful tips while waiting for pet assets.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, leading users to believe the application froze.

components.text: Generating custom pet animations for high DPI desktop displays...

candidates.title: Centered Path Selection Hub Layout
candidates.change: Change path selection layout to centered with a highlight badge on recommended pet creation paths.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean 514s; a centered visual hierarchy speeds up choice confidence.

candidates.title: Official Adoption Certificate Stamp Incentive
candidates.change: Add an official stamp visual and completion badge to the adoption certificate view.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest single-step completion rate (63.2%); visual reward incentives boost completion.
